free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the convergence of high-risk imaging and concerning clinical trends. The evidence shows a PI-RADS 5 lesion with a PSAD of 0.215 ng/mL/mL, coupled with a rising PSA velocity of 1.64 ng/mL/yr from 7.9 ng/mL two months prior. This finding strongly overrides the prior positive biopsy status, as the new imaging and trend suggest a change in clinical status warranting further tissue sampling.
